intent.assessment: Commercial discovery for established Shopify brands seeking ecommerce SEO and AI visibility support.

strengths: Title states Shopify specialization; H1 states the full-stack AEO proposition.
Named team, client testimonials, operating cadence and attributed revenue examples provide first-party proof.
The 90-day recalibration section explains how the work is revised.
checks: Metadata is present and the brand suffix appears once; no title rewrite is warranted from the sample alone.
The system section discusses collections, blog content and Reddit; the page-level links only lead to home, case studies and legal pages.
Revenue, timing and AI-effect claims are SEOasis statements and were not independently verified.

proposedTest.action: Retain the positioning and test one clear link from the method section to the selected Shopify commercial hub, plus an optional resource route.

pages.acceptanceGate: Founder confirms intended conversion path; approved destination is 200, canonical and indexable; link is crawlable, descriptive and usable on mobile; preserve the primary audit CTA.
pages.measurement: Requires Internal Access: GSC landing-page/query data and GA4 + CRM qualified audit requests. Compare qualified requests and navigation use; no CTR or revenue lift is assumed.

intent.assessment: Commercial investigation of collection/category-page SEO and how SEOasis builds revenue-focused ecommerce landing pages.

Broad claims about AI parsing, universal conversion uplifts and ranking timelines need evidence review before reuse in client documentation. They are not endorsed as facts here.

proposedTest.action: Make headings specific to category-page intent and add one contextual link to the technical implementation explanation if the account strategist confirms that destination.

pages.acceptanceGate: Use factual, supportable copy; no fixed word count or guaranteed ranking timeline as a release criterion; links match reader intent and approved page mapping.
pages.measurement: Requires Internal Access: GSC nonbrand query/page signals and qualified audit-request outcomes. For clients add inventory, margin and collection revenue before prioritizing scale.

intent.assessment: Buyer education before an agency decision; useful support for the primary Shopify commercial page.

strengths: Article names Mike Sack, has a publication date and a section-linked table of contents.
Questions about process, revenue reporting and platform experience support buyer decisions.
Commercial and related-article links give readers onward paths.
checks: Two source-HTML H2s read "Frequently Asked Questions"; the question "How to Choose the Right SEO Agency?" occurs twice outside scripts.
A contextual commercial link targets /best-shopify-seo-agency; the optimal primary commercial destination requires a query/page map.
Public HTML cannot reliably establish whether text was AI-authored. Editorial quality should be assessed through specificity, accuracy and evidence, not an AI detector.

proposedTest.action: Review whether the body FAQ and separate FAQ component intentionally repeat the same answers; keep one clear reader presentation if the rendered page confirms duplication.

pages.acceptanceGate: Check desktop/mobile rendering and accordion accessibility; one intended FAQ presentation; visible content and FAQ markup agree; author/date and useful section links remain present.
pages.measurement: Requires Internal Access: GSC informational and commercial query ownership plus GA4 article-to-audit journey and CRM quality. No assumed rich-result or AI citation benefit.
